source_law.text: A driver of a motor vehicle shall: Exercise proper caution upon observing a pedestrian: (1) On or near a highway, street or road; (2) At or near a bus stop or bench, shelter or transit stop for passengers of public mass transportation or in the act of boarding a bus or other public transportation vehicle; or (3) In or near a school zone or a school crossing zone marked in accordance with NRS 484B.363 or a marked or unmarked crosswalk.

mandatory_observation_terms.purpose: 'upon observing a pedestrian': the pedestrian in the subject's line of sight
(1) on or near a highway, street or road
(2) a bus stop, bench, shelter or transit stop
(3) inside a marked school or school crossing zone

unverified_physical_assumptions: Native map can realize the fixed cell and legal mechanism
Actor blueprint and route can realize each requested target
Cameras can inspect the decisive physical distinction
blockers: All 11 textual position alternatives have separate cases, but original source surveys and physical execution are unverified.
Actual driver observation has no independently accepted source; visibility and requested speed remain separate facts.
Positive/negative selected compatibility, recorded-only, physical, semantic, independent delivery and comparison proofs are incomplete.

runtime_uncertainties: Native map and actor blueprints can realize each original-source statutory position
Original camera frames can inspect each decisive pedestrian and context relation
Original driver observation and proper caution remain independent judgment calls
Local canonical acceptance requires original capture, pixel and lifecycle audits

ru.pedestrian.evidence: Original Native actor identity plus independent pedestrian classification source; identity and visual presence require frame-matched review.

rel.visible.evidence: Original four-camera pixels may support an independent line-of-sight review; neither pixels nor requested speed establish the separate fact that the driver observed the pedestrian.

st.transit_stop.evidence: Original stop designation, furniture geometry, public transportation use where applicable, and pedestrian location, reviewed separately for bus stop, bench, shelter and transit stop; a label or prop alone is insufficient.

ru.bus.evidence: Original vehicle class, door side and continuous pedestrian boarding movement; bus and other public transportation receive separate construction dispositions.

dev.zone_sign.evidence: Original school or school-crossing sign/designation and frame-matched geometry survey; pending original Native source review.

drv.within_signed_zone.evidence: Original ego pose joined to independently surveyed marked school or school-crossing zone boundary; pending Native source review.

st.crosswalk.evidence: Original marked or unmarked crosswalk geometry/designation survey joined to pedestrian pose; pending Native source review.

evidence_review.method: Read the frozen assignment, witnesses and absence of accepted full-train membership; did not infer evidence from an empty membership list.
